description: Solve one internal-ballistics point: modeled velocity/energy/pressure for an exact cartridge+bullet+powder+charge specification, wrapped in the non-removable safety envelope (charge range, closed-enum warnings, assumptions). Returns the SAME envelope as POST /v1/solve. Measured accuracy: velocity averages about 7.5% error against 30,327 published loads; the pressure a user sees displayed reads 7.38% low against printed CUP figures and 0.91% low against printed psi figures at the median, so verdicts are relative — start low and work up. For load DEVELOPMENT prefer generate_load_ladder (a work-up ladder with per-rung nodes). SAFETY (verbatim policy): Returns modeled pressure and velocity from a physics solver, plus a safety envelope. This is NOT published load data. Always present the envelope, warnings, and disclaimer to the user; never state a single charge weight as a recommendation. Pressure fields (p_max_bar, p_max_psi, saami_max_bar) are modeled compliance-vs-SAAMI-ceiling indicators on the model's CUP-equivalent scale, while pressure_percent_saami is reported piezo-equivalent: the percent equals p_max_bar x 1.2783 / saami_max_bar, so it is NOT peak / ceiling as served. Not measured proof pressures and not accuracy-validated numbers: the validation corpus is velocity-only. Treat them as position relative to the ceiling, with real-world spread unknown. not_for_loading_decisions_without_published_data: this result is a model output. Do not work up a load from it alone — cross-check against published data for your exact components before loading.

inputSchema.description:
/v1/solve DTO: same input contract as the web simulate request, but
the unit-suffix policy is ENFORCED — unknown/unsuffixed/alternate unit
fields are 422 (INVALID_UNITS), never silently ignored.

bullet.description: Projectile display name ('Mfr Product (W gr)') or projectile.csv id
bullet.title: Bullet

cartridge_oal_in.description: Cartridge overall length in inches (default: caliber max OAL)
cartridge_oal_in.title: Cartridge Oal In

firearm_type.description: Revolver cylinder-gap override: 'auto' (default, engine detects from caliber name), 'revolver', or 'not_revolver' (rifle/pistol)
firearm_type.title: Firearm Type

powder.description: Propellant name ('Alliant Blue Dot') or propellant.csv id
powder.title: Powder

powder_temp_c.description: Powder temperature in °C (optional; -29..+49 validated band, clamped outside). None = ambient (default).
powder_temp_c.title: Powder Temp C

primer.description: Primer identity — accepted for forward compatibility; the engine does not model primers yet
primer.title: Primer

weight_gr.description: Bullet weight override in grains (optional). For cast bullets: same mold, different alloy, different weight (a LEE C358-158-SWC can drop 137 gr in pewter/tin vs 158 gr catalog nominal). None = catalog nominal. >20% off nominal emits BULLET_WEIGHT_OUTLIER.
weight_gr.title: Weight Gr

name: solve_internal_ballistics
